title: The Velcro Idea Inspired by Burrs
short_teaser: George de Mestral examined burrs that clung to clothing and fur.
story: George de Mestral examined burrs that clung to clothing and fur. Under magnification, he saw tiny hooks and used the structure as inspiration for a new fastening system. Innovation can begin by asking how nature already solves a similar problem. Innovation is usually a chain of observations, tests, failures, adjustments, and connections that gradually become useful. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
